offering_description.value: Manages money market, fixed-income, equity, multi-asset and private-market investments for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors. It delivers these strategies through pooled funds and separately managed accounts and provides stewardship services to institutional investors.

primary_products.value: money market funds; fixed-income funds; equity funds; multi-asset funds; private-market funds

primary_services.value: institutional investment management; separately managed account management; shareholder engagement and proxy voting

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, broker-dealers, financial advisers, corporations, insurers, private pension plans and other institutional investors; B2C: individual investors buying funds or using adviser-managed accounts; B2G: public pension plans and government treasury offices

end_markets.value: cash and liquidity management; institutional investing; wealth management; retirement investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees based on assets under management and performance fees on certain strategies; service fees: fund administration and institutional stewardship services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools and invests client capital through funds sold to institutions, intermediaries and individuals; service provider: manages portfolios under client mandates and provides shareholder engagement and voting services to institutional investors

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, continental Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: liquidity, fixed-income, equity, multi-asset and private-market strategies, plus institutional stewardship

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: banks, trust companies and investment platforms; agents / brokers: broker-dealers and financial advisers; direct sales: institutional sales teams serving pension plans, corporations and public agencies
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; agents / brokers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: investment adviser and fund registration and oversight by the U.S. SEC and U.K. Financial Conduct Authority
